description: This source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class in an Android app, responsible for displaying detailed info about media content, fetching content details via network, and handling media playback using ExoPlayer. It manages UI elements, network requests, fullscreen toggling, and playback control.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Activity that displays content details, manages network requests for info and playback URLs, and controls media playback using ExoPlayer, including UI overlays and fullscreen toggling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads poster image, and fetches content info by ID.

methods.name: wirePlayerControls
methods.description: Attaches listeners to player control buttons for fullscreen and settings.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Binds click listeners to optional controller buttons if they exist.

methods.name: toggleFullscreen
methods.description: Switches the activity between fullscreen and normal modes by adjusting UI visibility and system bars.

methods.name: onSettingsClicked
methods.description: Stub for handling settings button click; shows a placeholder toast.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content details from server API and updates UI with title and description.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Initiates the process to get media URL from server and starts playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Initializes and plays media using ExoPlayer with specified media URL.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources when activity is destroyed.
